## Read in trend, current_status, and extent output files
```{r Read in and clean MANG data}
# Mangroves
MANG_current_status0 <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_mangroves/MAN_outputs/MANG_Status_1.1_Oct072026.csv")
MANG_extent0 <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_mangroves/MAN_outputs/MANG_Extent_1.1_Oct072026.csv")
MANG_trend0 <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_mangroves/MAN_outputs/MANG_Trend_1.1_Nov022026.csv")

colnames(MANG_current_status0)
MANG_current_status<- MANG_current_status0 %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, current_status= MANG_current_status, provenance, MANG_include_exclude)

colnames(MANG_extent0)
MANG_extent<- MANG_extent0 %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, extent_km2= area_est_byCEDO.2025_km2)

colnames(MANG_trend0)
MANG_trend<- MANG_trend0 %>%
  select(rgn_id, trend)

```

```{r Join MANG dataframes together}
# Join MANG trend, current_status, and extent
colnames(MANG_current_status)
colnames(MANG_extent)
colnames(MANG_trend)

MANG <- MANG_current_status %>%
  left_join(MANG_extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  left_join(MANG_trend,  by = c("rgn_id")) %>%
  mutate(habitat = "MANG") %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, current_status, extent_km2, trend, habitat, MANG_include_exclude) %>%
  mutate(
    current_status = round(current_status, 2),
    extent_km2 = round(extent_km2, 2)
  )
```

```{r Read in and clean CORL data}
# Coral Reefs
CORL_current_status0 <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_corals/CRL_outputs/CORL_Status_1.1_df_Oct072026.csv")
CORL_extent0 <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_corals/CRL_outputs/CORL_Extent_1.1_Oct072026.csv")
CORL_trend0 <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_corals/CRL_outputs/CORL_Trend_1.1_Nov022026.csv")

# NOTE TO SELF: Coral reef trend will change after this week, Nov 3 2026 - EMF
# In fact, I'll check all trends, to make sure they are right by the end of the week.

colnames(CORL_current_status0)
CORL_current_status<- CORL_current_status0 %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, current_status= CORL_current_status, provenance, CORL_include_exclude)

CORL_START= min(CORL_current_status0$year)
CORL_END= max(CORL_current_status0$year)

colnames(CORL_extent0)
CORL_extent <- CORL_extent0 %>%
  select(
    rgn_id,
    extent_ha = area_est_2025_ha
  ) %>%
  crossing(
    year = CORL_START:CORL_END
  ) %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, extent_ha) %>%
  arrange(year, rgn_id)


colnames(CORL_trend0)
CORL_trend<- CORL_trend0 %>%
  select(rgn_id, trend)

```

```{r Join CORL dataframes together}
# Join CORL trend, current_status, and extent
colnames(CORL_current_status)
colnames(CORL_extent)
colnames(CORL_trend)

CORL <- CORL_current_status %>%
  left_join(CORL_extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  left_join(CORL_trend,  by = c("rgn_id")) %>%
  mutate(habitat = "CORL") %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, current_status, extent_ha, trend, habitat, CORL_include_exclude) %>%
  mutate(
    current_status = round(current_status, 2),
    # Normalize hectares to km2
    extent_km2 = extent_ha/100,
    extent_km2 = round(extent_km2, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(-extent_ha)
```

```{r Join dataframes}
# Join dataframes
HS_df0 <- bind_rows(MANG, WETL, SEAG, CORL)

colnames(HS_df0)

HS_df<- HS_df0 %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, 
         habitat, current_status, extent_km2, trend)
```

```{r}
# Read in habitat service lit review scores for filtration, carbon sequestoration, and coastal protection
HS_weights0 <- read_csv("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/hs/HS_weights_updated_Nov032026.csv")
```

```{r Clean before merging}
# Select necessary columns and lowercase habitat names
colnames(HS_weights0)

HS_weights <- HS_weights0 %>%
  select(habitat= habitat_type, coastal_protection_score, filtration_score, sequestration_rate_gC.m2.yr)
```

```{r}
# Combine service weights and habitat data:

colnames(HS_df0)

HS_df <- HS_df0 %>%
  
  left_join(
    HS_weights,
    by = c("habitat" = "habitat")
  )
```

# Estimate PRO

```{r Calculate HS_current_status sub-scores}
colnames(HS_df)

# NOTE TO SELF: Possible units issue - Oct 2026


# Calculate carbon, filtration, and protection score
HS_current_status <- HS_df %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    PRO_score = sum(extent_km2 * coastal_protection_score * current_status, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(extent_km2 * coastal_protection_score, na.rm = TRUE),

    FIL_score = sum(extent * filtration * current_status, na.rm = TRUE) /
                       sum(extent * filtration, na.rm = TRUE),

    SEQ_score = sum(extent * carbon_sequestration_gC.m2.yr / 1,000,000 * current_status, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(extent * carbon_sequestration_gC.m2.yr / 1,000,000, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

HS_current_status
```
